daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

The Constitutional Court ruled that a challenge to Vice President Gibran's educational qualifications could not be accepted, concluding a case that had questioned whether he met the high school graduation requirement for candidacy. The court stated it had authority to hear the dispute but found no evidence Gibran possessed a high school-equivalent certificate, according to experts. Analysts described the ruling as "throwing the ball" back, leaving the matter unresolved despite the case being closed.

  • The DPR passed the Labour Protection Law, with the Manpower Minister stating it contains 13 new provisions including severance rules for terminations.
  • The KPK summoned Nusron Wahid as a witness today in a land rights bribery case.
  • The first trial for former Jampidsus Febrie Adriansyah is scheduled for today with the reading of charges.
  • President Prabowo stated that protecting state wealth will always face resistance, while he praised Indonesia's historic victory at the 2026 FIFA ASEAN Cup.
  • The Social Affairs Ministry sanctioned 620 employees over online gambling involvement.
  • Satgas PKH handed over 259,230.73 hectares of reclaimed land and will pursue companies that haven't paid fines, with potential criminal charges.
  • Three activists were appointed to palace positions, prompting analysis of their entry into government.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Indonesian ambassador confirmed that crew from the MT Honour 25 were freed through an armed operation after being held by Somali pirates, with Indonesia stating it did not meet the hijackers' demands. The government coordinated with multiple countries to secure the crew's release and will provide care for the freed crew. The ambassador also highlighted maritime cooperation opportunities with Puntland, Somalia.

  • Egypt's president will visit Indonesia after trips to South Korea and Malaysia.
  • Jakarta Deputy Governor Rano and Seoul representative Jeong Sang-hun strengthened Jakarta-Seoul friendship ties, with Rano attending an Indonesia festival in Seoul to strengthen cultural diplomacy.
  • The Trade Minister discussed trade barriers and investment with U.S. businessmen.
  • An Indonesia-PNG border trade fair will feature 66 small businesses.
  • Indonesian textile culture was showcased at ICWB 2026 in Antwerp, Belgium.

Other

Indonesia's state investment firm Danantara invested US$250 million in U.S. oil firm HighPeak, marking a significant overseas energy investment. Meanwhile, FTSE Russell maintained Indonesia's capital market status in the Emerging Market category. Indonesia is targeting Rp3,839 trillion in downstreaming investment through 2029.

  • Indonesia aims for a 20 percent bioethanol blend within five years and seeks to utilize degraded land for biofuel production.
  • The government stated that Indonesia sees no need to clear forests for new rice fields.
  • Bank Danamon and MUFG proposed a new name as their integration continues.
  • Indonesia urged MSMEs to adopt barcodes for modern retail access and will provide branding support to 500 MSMEs.
  • The Blok M total revitalization is targeted for completion in 2029.
